ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution shows a dominant low-intensity (black/dark-grey) surface area with high-intensity (white) patches appearing in an approximate 70:30 ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pigmentation is localized along the superior distal margins of both lobes, with a significant contiguous white region on the right distal lobe; the central peduncle attachment and lower-medial sections are characterized by solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees; vertical depth occupies ~12% of the total vertical pixel height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge exhibits fine-scale micro-serrations (2-4 pixel amplitude) along the medial portions, transitioning to large-scale, irregular jagged protrusions at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The upper boundary of the lobes follows a convex curve rising from the median notch and peaking at the distal-most tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular high-contrast pixel rings (white perimeter with dark interiors) concentrated in the lower-central black pigmentation zones of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of faint, unaligned diagonal linear streaks cutting through the high-intensity white pigmentation on the distal region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive, irregular calcified clusters (barnacles) localized on the extreme outer tips of both lobes, significantly altering the expected smooth geometric contour into bulbous silhouettes.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of individual isolated white circular 'punched-out' marks scattered across the central dark pigmentation, distinct from the dense clusters.
